text:
{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "old TX-200 units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disable the interface, wait about 30 seconds, and then enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Try to disable the interface, wait about 30 seconds, and then enable it again. Don't reboot the node, the port bounce usually does the trick.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "failed",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Tried the bounce, didn't help. Counters still stuck at zero after the disable/enable.",
    "about_entity": "TRN-019",
    "retracts": false
  },
  "reason": "The expert provides a reusable fix (port bounce, avoid reboot) for a known bug after SFP replacement on old TX-200 units when the link is up with zero counters, though the action failed in this case."
}
